mapper.sql: e.exam_id, e.exam_name, e.stage, e.grade, e.paper_id, p.paper_name, e.start_time, e.end_time, e.duration_minutes, e.status, e.create_by, e.create_time, e.update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM exam_info e LEFT JOIN paper_info p ON e.paper_id = p.paper_id WHERE e.exam_id = #{examId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO exam_info (exam_id, exam_name, stage, grade, paper_id, start_time, end_time, duration_minutes, status, create_by, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{examId}, #{examName}, #{stage}, #{grade}, #{paperId}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{durationMinutes}, #{status}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
